app.openError: The file could not be read: {{message}}

status.ok: No violations of the modeling rules.

issue.multiple-process-objects: Only one data object “process” is allowed per process. Also found: “{{element}}”.
issue.reference-without-state: “{{reference}}” points to the data object “process” but has no status. A status is required there.
issue.start-event-state: “{{element}}” is a start event and sets a status. The initial status is set by the first activity.
issue.unknown-state: The status “{{state}}” is not in the catalog.
issue.label-state-mismatch: The label says “{{label}}”, the dataState is “{{state}}”. “{{state}}” applies.
issue.state-only-in-label: The status “{{state}}” is only in the label, not a dataState.
issue.input-state-never-set: “{{element}}” documents the status “{{state}}”, which no step sets.
issue.state-key-conflict: The key “{{key}}” stands for “{{state}}” here and for “{{other}}” elsewhere.
issue.raci-missing-responsible: “{{element}}” has no R. Every user task needs exactly one, on the task or through its swimlane.
issue.raci-multiple-responsible: “{{element}}” has more than one R: {{assignees}}. Exactly one is allowed.
issue.raci-multiple-accountable: “{{element}}” has more than one A: {{assignees}}. At most one is allowed.
issue.lane-without-role: The lane “{{element}}” has no role or group. Every lane needs one.

panel.name: Name ({{language}})
panel.modelLanguageDescription: Names and descriptions in the diagram are in this language.
panel.statusDescription: From the catalog. The ID appears in square brackets in the name.
panel.statusOnlyProcess: Only the data object “{{name}}” has a status. This data object is documentation only.
panel.dataObjectIdDescription: The same for all references to this data object. The ID under “General” belongs to the individual reference.
panel.statusDescriptionFree: Pick a status used in the model or type a new one. It appears in square brackets in the name.

raci.title: Responsibilities (RACI)
raci.legend: R = responsible, A = accountable, C = consulted, I = informed
raci.fromLane: Comes from the swimlane. Change it via the role/group of the lane.

lane.title: Role/group
lane.description: From the catalog or typed freely. It is R for all tasks on the lane.
lane.poolDescription: From the catalog or typed freely. It is R for all tasks as long as the pool has no lanes.
lane.poolHasLanes: The pool has lanes. R always comes from the lane of the task.

picker.placeholder: Search or type a role or group …

profileHint.document: For diagrams that only document, for example from bpmn.io: tasks need no R and lanes no role.
profileHint.complete: All checks. Every user task needs an R, every lane a role or group.
profileHint.custom: Individual checks are switched on or off.

rule.multiple-process-objects: Only one data object “process” per process
rule.unknown-state: Status must be in the catalog (catalog only)
rule.state-only-in-label: Status is also stored as dataState
rule.state-key-conflict: A key stands for one status only
rule.raci-missing-responsible: Every user task has exactly one R
rule.raci-multiple-responsible: At most one R per task (except multi-instance)
rule.raci-multiple-accountable: At most one A per task
rule.raci-unknown-assignee: Roles and groups must be in the catalog (catalog only)
rule.lane-without-role: Every lane has a role or group

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.hint: Without a catalog you type statuses, roles and groups freely. With a catalog they are offered for selection, and the check reports what is missing there. The catalog is only stored in this browser.
catalog.empty: No catalog: statuses, roles and groups are free text.
catalog.applyHint: Apply rebuilds the modeler. Undo starts over afterwards.
catalog.idHint: Leave empty: the ID is derived from the name.

errors.invalid-json: The file is not valid JSON: {{message}}
errors.not-an-object: The file is not a catalog. Expected an object with “states”, “roles” and “services”.
errors.not-a-list: “{{table}}” is not a list and was skipped.
errors.invalid-entry: “{{table}}”, entry {{index}}: ID or name missing, skipped.

files.title: Working folder
files.unsupported: This browser cannot share a folder (e.g. Firefox). Opening and saving work by upload and download here. With Edge or Chrome you can choose a working folder, also on a network drive.
files.askName: What is your name? It is written into the lock file so others can see who is editing a file.
files.noFolder: Choose a folder for your models, e.g. on a network drive. Saving then writes directly to the file.
files.permission: After each restart the browser asks again whether bestbpmn may use the folder “{{folder}}”.
files.empty: There are no models (.bpmn) in the folder yet.
files.saveAsName: File name in the working folder:
files.lockedBy: “{{name}}” is being edited by {{user}} (since {{since}}) and cannot be overwritten.
files.conflict: “{{name}}” was changed by someone else since you opened it (last at {{time}}). Overwrite anyway? “Cancel” leaves the file unchanged.
files.readonlySave: You do not have “{{name}}” open for editing, so bestbpmn cannot save it in the folder. Download it instead?
files.reloadChanged: The file has changed in the meantime. Reload it? Your unsaved changes will be lost.
files.discard: There are unsaved changes. Continue anyway and discard them?

banner.locked: “{{name}}” is being edited by {{user}} (since {{since}}). You can view the file but not save it in the folder.
banner.stale: “{{name}}” is still locked for {{user}}, but there has been no sign of life since {{heartbeat}}, e.g. because the window crashed.
banner.lost: {{user}} has taken over the lock on “{{name}}”. Save your changes under another name or as a download.

report.fullPrint: Print full document / save as PDF
report.name: Name
